policy: All 101 original nominees remain in scope. A source failure is not a missing horse. Recent-form windows are never substituted for full-career statistics. Ratings systems remain separate and missing ratings are never inferred.

recentFormIntegrity.note: Evidence-backed false duplicate dates have been excluded and the canonical recent-form window rebuilt.

ratingsCoverage.unavailablePolicy: No R&S value is inferred where an explicitly labelled public R&S rating cannot be found. Timeform, RSSR, official handicap ratings, Racing.com WPR and unlabelled numeric fields are not substitutes.

freshPublicEvidence.scope: Asterix current 2026 preparation and stakes evidence: third in the G3 Naturalism Stakes over 2000m at Caulfield on 19 Sep behind Zahrann and Saint George; earlier 2026 G3 JRA Plate and G3 Tattersall's Cup wins captured with identity/pedigree, carried weights, going and margins where publicly exposed. No R&S rating inferred from unlabeled enhanced-form numbers.

Highwayman current 2026 Cup context: Joseph O'Brien identifies him as progressive after his G1 Betfred St Leger win; seven career starts at publication; official released Melbourne Cup weight independently corroborated at 56.5kg; Melbourne jockey plans remained undecided. No rating inferred.

Torranzino current 2026 preparation: nominated for the G3 JRA Cup (2000m), with Racing.com also identifying the G2 Feehan Stakes (1600m) as a possible spring kick-off. Article records his most recent race trip as a G3 Geelong Cup win followed by fifth in the 2025 Melbourne Cup. No rating inferred.

Shockletz won the 2500m Archer Stakes at Flemington and earned a Melbourne Cup ballot exemption. Racing.com explicitly published a new-peak WFA Performance Rating of 97, with a prior 2500m WPR of 96. The WPR is stored as Racing.com WPR only and is not substituted for R&S, Timeform, RSSR or official handicap ratings. Racing & Sports separately confirms the Cup berth and trainer campaign context.
Aethelwulf won the 2300m Newcastle Gold Cup on 18 Sep; career snapshot 7 starts/5 wins; released Cup weight 51kg; Bart Cummings or Metropolitan under consideration. No rating inferred.

Zahrann received a 0.5kg Melbourne Cup penalty after winning the Group 3 Naturalism Stakes, taking his Cup weight from 54.0kg to 54.5kg and moving him to 38th in order; Aethelwulf's Newcastle Gold Cup win passed the Melbourne Cup first elimination clause and moved him to 64th.
